subject: Questions on encryption evidence & intake process for FedRAMP/ISO audit
messages:
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmebank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@cloudaudits.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on encryption evidence & intake process for FedRAMP/ISO audit

Hi Vanessa (and team),

We're kicking off scoping for Acme Bank's FedRAMP Moderate assessment (June window) and an overlapping ISO 27001 certificate review. Before the auditor intake, we want to confirm what encryption/KMS evidence Redwood can provide out of the box vs what will require customer-side artifacts for Private deployments. Specific asks:

- KMS architecture diagram showing where keys are stored and who has access (cloud KMS vs customer-managed HSM).
- Evidence of key rotation events (sample logs or export) and a short description of rotation policy and cycle.
- HSM attestation/certificates if HSMs are in use for hosted deployments.
- Policy excerpts (encryption-at-rest, key management) we can include in our audit bundle.
- Any SOC 2 or other third-party reports you can provide as collateral.

We also want to know if Redwood can support auditor shadowing / live evidence review, and whether you maintain a standard intake spreadsheet for evidence intake (so we don't reformat everything during the audit). Pre-audit is scheduled for mid-May; can you confirm what you can deliver by May 5 so we can validate scope?

Thanks — appreciate a short list of deliverables and a point of contact.

Best,
Emily Ross
Director, Information Security
Acme Bank
security@acmebank.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmebank.com>, Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@cloudaudits.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on encryption evidence & intake process for FedRAMP/ISO audit

Emily — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and next steps at the bottom. Attaching a compact KMS diagram and a short policy extract to start (kms_key_diagram.pdf, enc-policy-extract.docx).

Short answers:
- Architecture: For Redwood Hosted we rely on cloud KMS (AWS KMS / Google KMS depending on region) and can provide attestation links and key usage diagrams. For Dedicated we run customer-dedicated hosts with tenant-isolated KMS; for Private deployments customers control keys (we provide guidance and an attestation template).
- Rotation evidence: We can provide sampled rotation events taken from our key-management logging pipeline (redacted event ids). Full log exports are not shared wholesale; auditors typically accept sampled exports plus a signed statement and ingestion mechanics.
- HSM attestation: For Hosted tiers where we use vendor HSM-backed keys we can share vendor attestation (where applicable). For Private, the customer controls the HSM and must provide local attestation — we can help with an example format.
- Policies and SOC2: policy excerpts attached; redacted SOC 2 report can be shared under an NDA / secure link (we will coordinate if you need the full report).

We can commit to delivering the attached diagram + policy excerpt within 3 business days. Rotation samples and a proposed redaction template within 7 business days. If you confirm the list of artifacts you want in the intake template, we'll populate the template with expected filenames and owners.

Proposed next steps:
1) Intake call — 30 minutes next week to align on artifacts and timing (suggest Tue or Wed mornings PT). Alan: would you like to join as auditor intake?
2) We'll produce: kms_key_diagram.pdf, enc-policy-extract.docx, fedramp-intake-template.xlsx (template) and a sample rotation export (redacted).
3) Olga will own the diagram and Priya will own the rotation sample and SOC collateral. Vanessa will be the external point of contact.

If that works I will circulate calendar invites and upload the template to a shared drive.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachments: kms_key_diagram.pdf (diagram, 1 page), enc-policy-extract.docx (excerpt, 2 pages)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on encryption evidence & intake process for FedRAMP/ISO audit

Internal — quick coordination note:

Vanessa — I'll take ownership of producing the KMS diagram (finalize by EOD Apr 27). I'll work with Platform Engineering to export a sample of rotation events (we should pull three rotation events per key family, redact principal identifiers, and include event hashes). Priya — can you pull the SOC2 redacted PDF and the vendor HSM attestation links?

Checklist I'm proposing to include in the intake template (short):
- policy_excerpt_encryption.pdf (owner: Priya)
- kms_key_diagram.pdf (owner: Olga)
- rotation_sample_export.csv (owner: Olga)
- hsm_attestation_links.txt (owner: Priya)
- soc2_redacted.pdf (owner: Priya)

Target internal deadlines: May 5 for all artifacts in the shared folder. I'll also draft an evidence narrative (one-pager) describing our logging and redaction process.

Note: engineering will need an audit window to run exports; I'll open a runbook ticket and tag infra-oncall.

—Olga
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@acmebank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Tucker <alan.tucker@cloudaudits.io>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on encryption evidence & intake process for FedRAMP/ISO audit

Vanessa/Olga — thanks, received the diagram and policy excerpt and the plan looks good. A couple quick asks before we lock the intake:

- Can you confirm which specific artifacts we should attach to the intake spreadsheet so the auditor has a one-click bundle (recommended: policy excerpt, diagram, rotation sample, HSM attestation, redacted SOC2).
- We prefer the intake call on Wed May 6 at 11:00 AM PT (works for Alan and our schedule) — please send an invite if that time works.
- For rotation samples, the auditor will want timestamps, key ids (redacted), and the rotation rationale; the CSV format is fine.

If you can drop the intake template (fedramp-intake-template.xlsx) and a shared drive link we will start populating. Looking forward to the intake call.

Best,
Emily
Director, Information Security
Acme Bank
